rain: Ana ruwa a Marlow Street, irin ruwan da ke danne ƙarar takun sawu.
tape: Jami'ar binciken laifuka Nia ta tsaya a bayan tef ɗin rawaya da aka yi shinge da shi, tana kallon lungu yana numfasawa da hasken ja da shuɗi.
tape.ask: Wace ce jami'ar binciken laifuka Nia?
body: An sami wani mutum can ƙarshen lungun, kusa da tsohon bangon bulo.
witness: Babu makami. Babu walat. Mashaidiya ɗaya tak: wata yarinya da ta rantse ba ta ga komai ba.
witness.ask: Me ya sa yarinyar ta ce ba ta ga komai ba?
streetlight: Amma fitilar titi da ke saman lungun ta yini tana ƙyallawa duk daren.
streetlight.ask: Me ya sa fitilar titin take ƙyallawa?
not-random: Nia ta lura cewa ƙyallawar tana bin wani tsari ne.
pattern: Takan ɗauke na daƙiƙa uku, sannan ta ƙyalla sau biyu.
message: Haka ta riƙa yi, kamar wani yana aika saƙo.
key: Ta bi tsarin ƙyallawar har zuwa sandar fitilar, ta sami wani ƙaramin mabuɗin tagulla da aka maƙala da tef a ƙasanta.
door: Mabuɗin ya dace da wata ƙofa da aka rufe da bulaye shekara ashirin da suka wuce.
door.ask: Wa ya rufe ƙofar da bulaye?
cupboard: A bayan bulayen akwai kabad, a cikinsa kuwa hoto ɗaya tak.
photo: Hoton ya nuna mashaidiyar tana ƙarama ƙwarai, tsaye kusa da mutumin da ya ɓace.
truth: Ba wai yarinyar ba ta ga komai ba ne. Ta ga komai, tana kuma jiran wanda zai yi mata tambayar da ta dace.
truth.ask: Me ya sa yarinyar take jira?
